alterations.description: The shot of female singer with her bust partially revealed
The shot of the dancer wiggling her hips
The shot of a man with a dagger in his back

The sequence of a girl reclining on Murli’s legs in a seductive pose and being turned into a skeleton

From the commentary: “This too is a present day reality, the wall built by the communist rule of the East Berlin to split the city, A gruesome sight, this iron curtain of two East blocks. Here the iron curtain is made of russiamatic, but no less impenetrable.”
The underlined word from the remark of Chandu: "Bombay ke hotelon men aise bi kaam karate hain" while he is seen to be cleaning utensils after spitting into them. (Sound).
Jagdish addressing Chandu as ‘Swine' (Sound).
From fighting scenes, near-views of direct arrow, spear and knife thrusts
Near-views of Otango, particularly close-ups of his face

From the scene of village destroyed by Otango, the sounds of groaning and screaming, particularly of the children. (Sound).
To a flash the shot of a man groaning while being experimented upon by Dr. Cyclops
To the minimum near-views of blue-coloured monster advancing towards Rita
To the minimum near-views of the dragon in Dr. Cyclops’ den
To a flash shots of Jagdish pointing scissors threateningly at Ajit
From Giulio’s dialogue “Put Your Arms Around Me And Enjoy Yourself.”
A tablet indicating that the story of the film is fictitious and does not represent the prevailing Customs traditions and conditions in the country and that it relates to pre-independence period.

Close shots of Indira’s scanty dress and exposed bosom, deleting shots of Bill kissing her.
Sambhuji fighting with tiger.
